title: PBA legends Patrimonio, Duremdes face off in Koronadal hometown game
summary: KORONADAL CITY, South Cotabato — Two Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) legends with roots in this city squared off for an exhibition game as part of the locality’s 26th city charter anniversary…

blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY, South Cotabato — Two Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) legends with roots in this city squared off for an exhibition game as part of the locality’s 26th city charter anniversary celebrations. But for Alvin “The Captain” Patrimonio, it was more than just another basketball exhibition game when he stepped onto the court here Tuesday night. The four-time PBA Most Valuable Player returned to a place closely tied to his family, becoming emotional as the city government honored him during the exhibition game.
